source_name: АТ «ОТП БАНК» (Ukraine) — документи щодо діяльності банку / річні звіти
why_relevant: Local Ukrainian disclosure of the OTP subsidiary: consolidated annual reports of the Ukrainian banking group with auditor's report, management report (звіт про управління), shareholder structure. Complements and cross-checks the Budapest parent disclosure in local currency and local accounting presentation.

source_name: ProCredit Holding AG — Investor Relations
why_relevant: Frankfurt-listed parent whose Ukraine bank is one of its largest and most-discussed exposures. Annual report, annual financial statements, impact report and quarterly results all break out Ukraine — including capital injections into ProCredit Bank Ukraine and German investment-guarantee coverage, which are strategy signals not visible in Ukrainian filings.

source_name: ProCredit Holding press-release / news stream
why_relevant: Ad-hoc and results press releases repeatedly name Ukraine explicitly (capital increases, RoE outlook, war-risk commentary). Higher frequency and earlier than the annual report; good early-warning channel for group decisions about the Ukrainian subsidiary.

source_name: Credit Agricole Bank Ukraine — Documents and reports (Документи та звіти)
why_relevant: Crédit Agricole S.A. does not break Ukraine out as a named segment in Paris reporting, so the Ukrainian subsidiary's own bilingual (uk/en) documents-and-reports page is the primary disclosure channel: constituent documents, audited financial statements, capital and solvency ratios.

source_name: Credit Agricole Bank Ukraine — press centre quarterly financial-results releases
why_relevant: The bank issues a structured, comparable results release every quarter (Q1, H1, 9M, FY) in both Ukrainian and English with net banking income, net profit, loan portfolio splits (Corporate vs Proximity), cost-to-income, CET1/solvency/leverage. Effectively a French-standard IR communication published on a .ua domain — high-frequency, machine-parseable, easy to time-series.

source_name: Crédit Agricole S.A. Group financial publications (International Retail Banking)
why_relevant: Paris parent's universal registration document and quarterly results packs. Ukraine sits inside the International Retail Banking / 'other international' line rather than a named segment, but M&A and country-risk commentary (e.g. the Bank Lviv acquisition) surfaces here first. Track as a lower-granularity but authoritative confirmation channel.

source_name: Bank Lviv (АТ АКБ «Львів») — NBU institution page and bank site
why_relevant: Newly entering the foreign-parent perimeter: Crédit Agricole Ukraine agreed to acquire up to 100% of Bank Lviv (announced 2026). Tracking the NBU institution and ownership-structure pages captures the moment its disclosures migrate into the Crédit Agricole group channel, and documents the pre-acquisition baseline.

source_name: KredoBank (PKO Bank Polski group) — consolidated annual report
why_relevant: Largest Polish-controlled bank in Ukraine (~12th by assets). Publishes a consolidated group annual report in Ukrainian; the Warsaw parent additionally describes it in its own group reporting. A second, non-Austrian/Hungarian instance of the same 'foreign parent + country annex' pattern the cell targets.

source_name: PKO Bank Polski — KredoBank / international banking corporate pages and group reports
why_relevant: Warsaw parent's view of its Ukrainian subsidiary: group-level segment notes and corporate-group pages describe KredoBank's contribution, strategy and Ukraine exposure. Same structural channel as RBI/OTP but in the Polish disclosure ecosystem.

source_name: NBU supervision — banks register, ownership structures and foreign-capital classification
why_relevant: Authoritative actor map for this cell: identifies which Ukrainian banks belong to foreign banking groups (NBU defines 'банк з іноземним капіталом' as >=10% foreign investor share) and publishes shareholder structures. Use it to keep the parent-group watchlist complete and current rather than relying on a fixed name list.

source_name: Cbonds — issuer profile pages for Ukrainian foreign-owned banks (e.g. OTP Bank Ukraine)
why_relevant: Aggregates issuer identifiers (TIN, LEI, SWIFT), credit ratings and normalised accounting/financial report tables for the Ukrainian subsidiaries. Useful as an entity-resolution key linking the local subsidiary to its foreign parent's filings, and as a cross-check on reported figures.

source_name: Quartr — RBI and OTP investor-relations/earnings-call aggregation
why_relevant: Aggregates earnings-call audio/transcripts and IR decks for the parent groups. Analyst Q&A on the calls is often where Ukraine-specific colour (war risk, tax, capital repatriation, sale intentions) is given that never appears in the written report.

source_name: Investing.com earnings-call transcripts (ProCredit Holding)
why_relevant: Free full transcripts of ProCredit Holding calls in which Ukraine performance and default rates are discussed explicitly. A practical substitute where the issuer does not publish a written transcript.

source_name: ПУМБ (FUIB) — Річні звіти / фінансова звітність
why_relevant: PUMB/FUIB is Ukraine's largest domestic privately owned bank (SCM group). Its statutory annual reports with IFRS statements and independent auditor reports are published here; the parent /finance hub also holds quarterly statements and performance indicators.

source_name: FUIB — Annual reports (English mirror)
why_relevant: English-language mirror of PUMB's statutory reporting — the cleanest English route to a Ukrainian private bank's audited results, useful for cross-checking translated figures and for Eurobond-era investor material.

source_name: ПУМБ — Регульована інформація емітента / загальні збори акціонерів
why_relevant: Securities-issuer regulated disclosure: shareholder meeting notices, special information (особлива інформація), ownership structure and issuer policies. This is the channel where material corporate events surface before press coverage.

source_name: АТ «Універсал Банк» (monobank) — Фінансова звітність
why_relevant: Universal Bank is the licensed entity behind monobank — by far the most commercially interesting Ukrainian challenger. Its audited IFRS statements are the only hard numbers behind monobank's growth claims.

source_name: monobank / Universal Bank — Новини (press releases, results announcements)
why_relevant: monobank announces client-count milestones, product launches and year-in-review results through the Universal Bank newsroom (e.g. the 2023 results post). Fastest indicator of neobank traction between statutory filings.

source_name: АТ «А-БАНК» — Звітність та документи (про банк / reports)
why_relevant: A-Bank is a major domestic private retail/consumer-credit bank (Surkis-linked ownership) with a strong digital card business. Its reports page holds annual financial statements, supervisory board reports and auditor conclusions.

source_name: АТ «БАНК КРЕДИТ ДНІПРО» — розкриття інформації / фінансова звітність
why_relevant: Credit Dnipro is a mid-size domestic private bank (Yaroslavsky) with an active agro and retail push. Site carries an information-disclosure section, ownership structure, financial statements and bank indicators.

source_name: «Правила розкриття інформації АТ «БАНК КРЕДИТ ДНІПРО» (disclosure policy PDF)
why_relevant: A bank's own disclosure rulebook enumerates exactly what it must publish, where, and on what cadence — an excellent template for building a checklist of expected artefacts across all Ukrainian private banks.

source_name: АТ «ВСТ БАНК» / ПАТ «БАНК ВОСТОК» — фінансова звітність та документи
why_relevant: Bank Vostok (rebranding to VST BANK; Fozzy-linked owners Kostelman/Morokhovskyi) is a significant private bank with heavy card-acquiring and payment activity — directly relevant to payments intelligence. Signed IFRS statements with auditor reports are published as PDFs.

source_name: Bank Vostok banking group consolidated IFRS statements (incl. АТ «ВЕРМОНТ»)
why_relevant: Group-level consolidated statements reveal the non-bank financial companies sitting alongside the bank — useful for mapping payments/fintech subsidiaries not visible in solo bank reporting.

source_name: ПуАТ «КБ «АКОРДБАНК» — Звітність (annual reports directory)
why_relevant: Accordbank is a domestic privately owned bank whose annual report PDFs sit on a stable, predictable path (docs/accounting/annual/{year}/richnyi_zvit_{year}.pdf) — a low-friction, high-yield collection target including management report and independent auditor's report.

source_name: АТ «АБ «РАДАБАНК» — Фінансова звітність / інформація для акціонерів
why_relevant: Radabank is a Dnipro-based private bank active in retail payments; it publishes both IFRS statements and NSSMC-format issuer filings (titled XML/PDF forms) on its own site.

source_name: АТ «ЮНЕКС БАНК» — Щомісячна / фінансова звітність
why_relevant: Unex Bank is a small private bank that publishes monthly reporting — a higher-frequency series than annual reports, useful for early trend detection among challengers.

source_name: АТ «БАНК АЛЬЯНС» — Щорічна фінансова звітність
why_relevant: Bank Alliance is a fast-growing domestic private bank; its annual reports and management reports are posted as single consolidated PDFs on a stable path, with an English section too.
